faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start working together.

items.question: What kind of marketing do you specialize in?
items.answer: We specialize in the intersection of traditional performance marketing and the emerging AI-native economy. This includes GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AI-powered PPC, and full-stack product marketing for Web2 and Web3 brands.

items.question: How do I get started working with you?
items.answer: The process begins with a 30-minute discovery call where we audit your current growth architecture and identify leakage points. From there, we deliver a custom strategy roadmap. If aligned, we can begin high-impact execution within 72 hours.

items.question: Who do you typically partner with?
items.answer: We work with businesses of all sizes, from funded startups to established enterprises. What matters most is alignment on goals and a commitment to growth. Our strategies scale to match your budget and ambitions.

items.question: Can I book a call to discuss my project?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer free discovery calls to understand your needs and explore how we can help. You can book directly through our calendar on the site.

items.question: What makes your approach different?
items.answer: We combine over a decade of marketing experience with modern AI-native workflows that increase speed and precision. We treat your growth like our own, focusing on unit economics rather than vanity metrics.

items.question: What challenges do you help businesses overcome?
items.answer: We help brands solve distribution moats, scale user acquisition through predictive ads, and modernize their SEO strategies for the era of AI search (GEO).

items.question: How do you integrate AI into your marketing strategy?
items.answer: We use autonomous agents for deep market research, predictive modeling for ad spend optimization, and generative engines to ensure your brand is cited by LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude.

items.question: Do you offer full-cycle product development?
items.answer: Yes, we build high-conversion websites, SaaS applications, and decentralized protocols (Web3) designed specifically to support aggressive growth and scalability.

items.question: What core services do you provide?
items.answer: Our core expertise includes GEO & LLM Optimization, Predictive Performance Ads (PPC), Web3 Engineering, and Fractional CMO services for strategic leadership.

items.question: What is GEO and why is it important in 2026?
items.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensures your brand is the primary source cited in AI-generated search answers. As users move away from traditional search bars, GEO is the new SEO.

items.question: Do you manage Paid Ads across all platforms?
items.answer: Yes. We manage high-performance campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and crypto-native networks like Etherscan and Twitter (X), optimized for the highest ROAS.

items.question: What is a Fractional CMO, and do I need one?
items.answer: A Fractional CMO provides executive-level marketing leadership at a fraction of the cost of a full-time hire. This is ideal for startups skaling to Series A/B that need strategic direction without the high overhead.

items.question: How long before I see results?
items.answer: PPC campaigns can generate leads within days. With our GEO strategies, clients typically see meaningful increases in AI mentions and organic awareness in just 3-4 weeks.

items.question: How do you measure and report on results?
items.answer: Transparency is core to our model. You'll receive real-time data dashboards and regular reports with clear KPIs, focusing on CPA, ROAS, and customer lifetime value (LTV).

items.question: Do you provide performance forecasting?
items.answer: Yes. Before we scale budgets, we use predictive AI to forecast potential outcomes, ensuring every dollar spent is backed by data-driven probability.

items.question: How do you track success in Web3 and Decentralized growth?
items.answer: Beyond traditional analytics, we track on-chain metrics, wallet retention, and community missionary growth to ensure long-term protocol health.
